en.name: Fisherman
en.ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller for some advice to help your team win.
en.flavor: This was my favourite part of the river... see how the sunlight makes a rainbow from the monastery to the market? This was the best place for big fish. And the older I get, the bigger they were.
